title: Pass 1: Summary + Factual Content
description: Extracts what happened, what was discussed, and factual content from a conversation.

summary.description: 2-4 sentence summary of what happened in this conversation.

significance.description: Why this conversation matters, if it does. Null if routine/unremarkable.

significance_categories.description: Categorical tags for the significance of the conversation. Use [] when significance is null or routine.

context.description: Brief context for how this topic came up.

topics_and_interests.description: Subjects discussed with their centrality to the conversation.

title.description: Name of the work, creator, or thinker.

relationship.description: How the user relates to this item.

context.description: Brief context for why this was mentioned.

media_and_influences.description: Books, films, games, music, podcasts, creators, thinkers referenced.

skill.description: Language, framework, tool, or technical domain.

proficiency_signal.description: Apparent skill level based on how the user engages with it.

context.description: How this skill surfaced in the conversation.

technical_stack_and_skills.description: Technical skills, languages, frameworks, and tools discussed.

negative_space.description: Brief notes about meaningful things that were looked for but not present or why the conversation yields little enduring value.
